'''Rosebud''' is the name of [[Selucia]]'s horse.

==Appearance==
Rosebud is a dun colored mare.

==Activities==
After [[Matrim Cauthon]] bought [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] [[Akein]], Selucia buys Rosebud.{{ref/book|11|10}} Rosebud carries Selucia during her travels across [[Altara]] and back to [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|11|26}}{{ref/book|11|27}}{{ref/book|11|36}}
